summary: Central Puerto S.A., an Argentine electric utility listed in the US via ADSs, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its condensed consolidated financial statements and statutory review reports for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, signed by auditor Pistrelli, Henry Martin y Asociados (PwC affiliate) on November 6, 2026. Revenue reached ARS 1.79 trillion versus ARS 783.6 billion a year earlier, with operating profit of ARS 517.6 billion and net pre-tax gain of ARS 516.4 billion; capital comprises 1.513 billion ordinary shares, including 15.5 million treasury. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure under US domestic equivalent Form 10-Q, containing no transaction, tender, activist or structural event; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
